vastu/entrances/padas.yaml.basis: For a confirmed cardinal plan wall, measure the doorway midpoint along its length clockwise from the named corner. The eight equal wall intervals are a modern lookup convention using the classical sequence; these are not compass wedges.
vastu/entrances/padas.yaml.interpretation: The position identifies an entrance tradition for admin review. No independent outcome or automatic change of the room tone.
vastu/entrances/padas.yaml.interval: For 0 <= distance < wall_length, index = 1 + floor(8 * distance / wall_length). At an exact terminal corner use position zero on the next clockwise wall. Withhold if the wall or midpoint is uncertain.

sources.supports: Outer deity order and side-specific doorway sequence. Romanization follows the named edition.

compass.declination_deg: signed degrees, required for magnetic bearings
compass.provenance: preserve observation date, location and declination source with any correction
compass.reference: true-north or magnetic; true-north is represented by the string 'true'

optional.entrance: cardinal wall, wall length and clockwise distance to opening midpoint in the same units
optional.plot: confirmed land footprint shape, level flag, and true downhill bearing if sloping

rooms.bearing_deg: finite numeric degrees, required for noncentral room
rooms.id: unique nonempty string within this dwelling
rooms.uncertainty_deg: optional nonnegative angular half-width; default zero. Suppress a classification that changes anywhere in the uncertainty interval.
rooms.use: one of rooms in this profile

house_check.route: House mode joins independently matched layout observations with the optional number check and stable natal fourth-house/Moon context. Only fire Moon-in-fourth when that actual placement holds. City-only mode uses destination coordinates at the birth instant; no rooms, door padas or house number inferred. Use parent recipe for combined evidence.

input.central_region: On a confirmed rectangular plan the middle third on both axes is the centre (each interval includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound). A central room has no angular bearing. Unknown centre membership or uncertain boundaries yield no room reading.
input.declination_deg: Signed east-positive local declination for the measurement date and location; use true = (magnetic + declination) modulo 360. Never apply declination twice. Missing correction leaves magnetic bearings unresolved.
input.plot: Optional observed land footprint and downhill direction on a plot; use no plot reading for a flat or unknown land information.
input.room_list: Each observation supplies a unique room ID, use, verified position in unit, central-region flag and a degree bearing clockwise from north from the unit centre to the room midpoint. For a tank record type and whether it belongs to this unit. Record outward-facing door bearing separately.
input.zones: Index = floor((true_bearing + half_sector_width) / sector_width) modulo sector_count. For the sixteen-zone option retain the exact narrower label but calculate the eight-sector room lookup independently from the same true bearing.

rendering.policy: Choose the rule for the identified room and zone. Use the tank subtype override when applicable. For several rooms retain their own labels; a combined summary is Steady for mixed or all-context observations, otherwise use the sole directional tone. No numeric aggregation.
rendering.rental: All room texts use free, reversible arrangements of existing space. Flats use the unit footprint and exclude shared installations. Tenure never increases a caution tone.
